1. Read the weights. Fall back to the default if they are negative or add up to 0.
2. Pad the image with the border mode.
3. For each pixel, add each weight to the histogram bin of the value under it.
4. Walk the bins from 0 up until the running weight reaches half of the total, and write that value.
